title: Lower bound on Dirac resonances with mass-type potentials in the semi-classical limit
summary: We establish lower bounds on the number of resonances for three-dimensional semiclassical Dirac operators with mass-type potentials. For a pair $\Dl_j=\Dl_0+\mbfβv_j$, $j=1,2$, satisfying the exterior analyticity, decay and non-degeneracy assumptions of the paper, we associate a relative distribution $μ$ to the corresponding mass functions. We prove that if $E_0>1$ is a boundary point of $\suppμ$, then every complex neighbourhood of $E_0$, and likewise of $-E_0$, contains in total at least $C\hbar^{-3}$ resonances of the two operators, counted with multiplicity.
